name: Miwaku no Mahoujin -Wakaoku-sama to Ecchi na Shoukan Mahou-
original_name: 魅惑の魔法陣 -若奥様とエッチな召喚魔法-
source:
Alicia is a newly-fledged summoner, and a housewife with a little body.
One day, she finds out her husband, a poor, lower-class soldier, has a large debt.
Abandoned herself to despair once, but she has a great chance to life herself out of poverty, but it is not that easy..... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE030565.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
Alicia是一名刚刚出道的召唤师，也是一位身材娇小的家庭主妇。
一天，她发现担任低阶士兵、收入微薄的丈夫欠下巨额债务。
她一度陷入绝望，后来获得一个摆脱贫困的绝佳机会，然而事情并没有那么简单…

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE030565.html]DLSite English[/url]]
